description:
Price of one medicine with the free FineRx card at US pharmacy chains, near a place.

    Use when the person asks what a medicine costs, where it costs less, or its
    price near them or in a ZIP code. ``drug`` is a name as typed or a slug from
    search_drugs; ``strength`` ("10 mg"), ``form`` ("tablet") and ``quantity``
    are optional (the package with the most chains priced is used). ``zip`` is a
    5-digit US ZIP — pass it only when the person gave one; without it the host's
    approximate location is used when there is one, else the answer is national
    and asks for a ZIP. ``ndc`` (+ ``quantity``) is accepted for older callers.
    ``compare_to`` is a dollar amount the person named for THIS package — their
    insurance copay, what they pay now, or a price they want to hear about —
    and the answer then says how many chains were seen below it.

    Returns the package, every chain's card price with its observation date
    (Walmart per state), the nearest store of each chain with a store nearby,
    chains with a card price but no store nearby, coverage (``other_quantities``
    lists the pack sizes that were seen), and the card: codes, the dated price
    with the card, and the card sentence.

    Next: quote each price with its date and chain; say the price is set per
    chain; then the card sentence and codes.

channel.description: An optional channel tag identifying where the request comes through; leave it out unless the calling host supplies one.
channel.title: Channel

compare_to.description: A dollar amount the person named for this package (their insurance copay, what they pay now, or a price they want to beat); the answer then says how many chains were seen below it.
compare_to.title: Compare To

drug.description: The medicine: a name as typed, or a slug from search_drugs.
drug.title: Drug

form.description: The dosage form of the medicine (e.g. "tablet").
form.title: Form

locale.description: A language code for the answer (the host's own is used when left out).
locale.title: Locale

ndc.description: The medicine's NDC (National Drug Code); accepted together with quantity for older callers.
ndc.title: Ndc

quantity.description: The quantity to price (the pack size / number of units).
quantity.title: Quantity

strength.description: The strength of the medicine (e.g. "10 mg").
strength.title: Strength

zip.description: A 5-digit US ZIP code to locate prices and stores near; pass it only when the person gave one.
zip.title: Zip

name: compare_prices
